comment: AURORAL PROCESSION REGROWTH, SAME-PHASE CAST (Bruna sideboard, 2026-10-06). Eight mana, Mother of Runes on board, Auroral Procession in hand, Prodigious Growth in the graveyard. Procession ({G}{U}) returns Growth -- a tutor whose zone is the GRAVEYARD (tutor_from_graveyard), so the returned card rides the mid-phase acquisition re-solve -- and Growth ({4}{G}{G}, +7/+7) goes on Mother THE SAME main phase: 1 + 7 = 8 = the opponent's life. No Bruna on board, so her graveyard gather is not an alternative route. Control: at opponent life 9 this must NOT win on turn 4.
